name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 49
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1w. Stresses that mere compliance with EU labelling obligations for products originating in illegal Israeli settlements is insufficient; calls instead for a total ban on the import, sale and circulation within the EU of all goods and services produced in Israeli settlements, as they directly derive from and sustain apartheid policies and the illegal occupation of Palestinian territories, in violation of international law;
